title: Milestone M1 application payloads and tool inputs
description: Application-scoped schemas only. Official MCP schemas define envelopes, discovery/list/call, request metadata, cache fields, CallToolResult, InputRequiredResult, inputResponses, and version errors.

debugSessionId.description: Opaque server-minted process-local capability; format is private. `required`/`minLength` advertise a valid capability-bearing call. Direct runtime maps a missing `debugSessionId` or non-empty short/malformed token string uniformly to not-found; empty/whitespace, non-string, and extra-field shapes are invalid arguments.

inspectionContextId.description: Opaque process/session-local stopped-epoch token, obtained from get_call_stack with includeInspectionContext=true or from a successful set_variable. A mutation replaces the previous context. Carry each numeric ID with the context from the same observation; the token does not prove that the numeric ID was ever issued. Execution, stopped replacement, terminal, invalidated, thread-exit, reader failure and cleanup invalidate the inspection epoch session-wide.

initialBreakpoint.description: Initial setBreakpoints response only; not a breakpoint-hit or later verification report.

evaluateExpressionArguments.description: All inputs are explicit. DAP watch can execute code or mutate the debuggee; it is not read-only or idempotent.

expression.description: Forwarded exactly once, unchanged, with the explicit frameId and DAP context watch. No automatic retry or implicit frame selection.

hwnd.description: Opaque lossless handle string echoed from discovery; comparison only, never target selection.

line.description: Requested source line, not an adapter adjustment.
Requested source line, not an adapter adjustment.

name.description: Runtime additionally enforces a maximum of 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
Runtime additionally enforces a maximum of 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

value.description: No smaller per-value limit; the complete serialized success structuredContent is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes inclusive.

type.description: Null when the adapter omits type. Runtime limits a present string to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

variablesReference.description: Zero marks an output leaf only and is never valid as get_variables input.

scopesSuccess.description: Complete serialized structuredContent is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes inclusive.

variablesSuccess.description: Complete serialized structuredContent is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes inclusive.

exceptionInfoSuccess.description: Current stopped-thread observation. The complete serialized structuredContent is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes inclusive; the exception body is preserved without truncating nested details or extension fields.

evaluateSuccess.description: Complete serialized structuredContent is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes inclusive. Success is a current adapter response, not a read-only or no-side-effect claim.

type.description: Null when the adapter omits type or explicitly returns null. A present string is limited to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

variablesReference.description: A positive reference can be expanded with get_variables using the same current inspectionContextId; zero is a leaf.

setVariableSuccess.description: The complete serialized result is bounded to 262144 UTF-8 bytes. The returned context replaces the old context; mutation is not read-only or idempotent.

reason.description: Actual adapter stop reason, bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Unfamiliar valid reasons are preserved.

acknowledged.description: A positive correlated acknowledgement was observed before this waiter finalized. An acknowledged fully written continue detaches without shutting down the session; an unacknowledged possible write is drained before return.

dapExceptionInfoUnsupported.description: The capability was absent or false at admission; no exceptionInfo request was written. Revocation alone does not invalidate an already admitted response in the same stopped epoch.

dapExceptionInfoRefused.description: The stopped target was unavailable or stale, the adapter refused the request, or lifecycle invalidation preceded reader correlation. No stale exception body is returned and no retry is performed.

dapExceptionInfoProtocolError.description: A malformed, oversized, timed-out or failed exchange uses lease-release-before-close-and-drain and returns no adapter diagnostic or exception body.

dapEvaluateRefused.description: The inspection context was unavailable or stale before writer handoff; no evaluate request was sent.

dapEvaluateFailed.description: The adapter returned a negative evaluate response. Expression side effects may already have occurred; no no-effect claim or automatic retry follows.

dapEvaluateOutcomeUnknown.description: A stale post-write response or malformed, oversized, timed-out or failed exchange cannot establish a usable result or absence of expression effects. The session is drained; never retry automatically. Caller cancellation after a possible write also invalidates inspection and drains before server cleanup finishes, without inventing a result.
